title: Ozon Now Pays More Than Three Times as Much to Insure Its Goods
subtitle: After repeated drone attacks the marketplace raised the insurance cost of goods by 230% and began fitting flame-resistant fibreglass panels to warehouse roofs.

source.name: Ozon corporate disclosures and Russian market reporting

data.label: Insurance cost after repricing
data.annotation: A 230% increase applied to goods moving through the network.

supportingFacts.label: The share price fell sharply when a drone struck near an Ozon facility, closing the session down more than 3%.
Flame-resistant panels are being installed on facility roofs as physical protection against strikes.
Magnit shut its own online marketplace early and said it would move to a different format.

metadata.keyFinding: Ozon raised the cost of insuring goods by 230% while hardening warehouse roofs against drones.
